title: Pretty but very strong
text: Pretty but very strong. These tie baks are nice looking and easy to use but the magnets are pathetically weak. You really have to pull the cord tight then make sure there is absolutely no tension on the magnets to get them to work, even with light curtains. With my heavier blackout curtains they failed about half the time and I just gave up on using them for those at all. Overall they are just ok, a stronger magnet would instantly make these a million times better.
